name: containers
description: Docker containers and images, grouped by Compose project: start, stop, restart and remove them, follow their logs and open a shell in a terminal. Agents can list them, read their logs and, when you approve, restart them or bring a Compose project up

containers.command.title: Docker command
containers.command.description: The Docker CLI to run (a path, or `podman` for Podman's Docker-compatible CLI).

containers.shell.title: Shell
containers.shell.description: The program Open Shell runs in a container (`bash`, `sh`, `ash`…).

containers.logLines.title: Log lines
containers.logLines.description: How many of a container's last log lines Follow Logs shows before following new ones.

containers.confirmRemove.title: Confirm before removing
containers.confirmRemove.description: Ask before removing a container or an image, or taking a Compose project down.
